welcome_message:
Hello! My name is **{}**

I am CS:GO case unboxing and economy bot. With me you can:
• Unbox your dream skins
• Trade them with other users
• Take a risk and upgrade them
• And more coming soon!

By default, users can open cases in any channel where they can type. This can cause a lot of clutter, so it is recommended you use `{}config` to set up a room creation channel so users can unbox in their own threads

Enjoy! - [Spacerulerwill](https://github.com/Spacerulerwill)

Use `{}info` to see this message again at anytime

trades.embed.commands.value:
`{}trade in <user>` - view incoming trade from user
`{}trade out <user>` - view outgoing trade to user
`{}trade accept <user>` - accept trade from user
`{}trade decline <user>` - decline trade from user
`{}trade cancel <user>` - cancel trade to user
